spans.s: 1. हेष् (cf. √ ह्रेष्) cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xvi, 20) हे॑षते (Ved. ep. also ˚ति; p. हे॑षत्, RV.; MBh.; हेषमाण, Hariv.; pf. जिहेषिरे, Śiś.; fut. हेषिता &c. Gr.), to neigh, whinny, RV.; &c.
2. हेष् (prob. connected with √ 1. हि), to be quick or strong or fiery (in the following derivatives) :
quick, strong (in हेष॑-क्रतु, ‘of strong power’, others ‘roaring mightily’, applied to the Maruts), RV. iii, 26, 5.
Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to neigh, whinny, Pañcat.
quick, strong (in हेष॑-क्रतु, ‘of strong power’, others ‘roaring mightily’, applied to the Maruts), RV. iii, 26, 5.
हे॑षस्—वत् (हे॑षस्-), mfn. quick, strong, fiery, RV. vi, 3, 3.
